name: 홈 접기 전부 열림
js: document.querySelectorAll('main details, article details, details').forEach(d => d.open = true); await new Promise(s => setTimeout(s, 50));

name: D04 흐름 중간에서 멈춤
js: const r = document.querySelector('section.flow[data-flow]'); r.querySelectorAll('details.flow-cause').forEach(d => d.open = true); await new Promise(s => setTimeout(s, 50)); const n = +r.querySelector('[data-flow-count]').textContent.split('/')[1]; for (let k = 0; k < Math.floor(n / 2); k++) r.querySelector('[data-flow-next]').click(); r.querySelector('[data-flow-play]').click(); r.querySelector('[data-flow-play]').click();
